name: eaon-code-monorepo
description: Eaon Code — Eaon's full-screen terminal coding agent

scripts.build: cd packages/chord && bun run build && cd ../tui && bun run build && cd ../telemetry && bun run build && cd ../ai && bun run build && cd ../agent && bun run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && bun run build && cd ../../protocol && bun run build && cd ../client && bun run build && cd ../server && bun run build && cd ../mcp && bun run build && cd ../codemode && bun run build && cd ../coding-agent && bun run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/chord && bun run build && cd ../tui && bun run build && cd ../telemetry && bun run build && cd ../ai && bun run build:offline && cd ../agent && bun run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && bun run build && cd ../../protocol && bun run build && cd ../client && bun run build && cd ../server && bun run build && cd ../mcp && bun run build && cd ../codemode && bun run build && cd ../coding-agent && bun run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && bun run check:pinned-deps && bun run check:runtime-deps && bun run check:ts-imports && bun run check:entry-graphs && bun run check:shrinkwrap && bun run check:install-lock:coding-agent && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:browser-smoke
scripts.test: bun run test:scripts && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.version:patch: node scripts/bump-version.mjs patch && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: node scripts/bump-version.mjs minor && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: node scripts/bump-version.mjs major && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run check
